Real talk: does anyone actually understand how their phone works? I use this thing fourteen hours a day and I couldn't begin to explain what's happening inside it. There's a tiny computer in my pocket that can access all of human knowledge, and I mostly use it to look at pictures of dogs and argue with strangers. Great use of technology.

The speed of it all gets me. My grandparents had to go to a library and look stuff up in actual books. I can ask my phone a question and get an answer in two seconds. That's insane! We don't appreciate that enough.

What I can't stand is when stuff doesn't work. Nothing makes you feel more helpless than when your wifi goes out. You're standing there, restarting the router for the fifth time, holding it above your head like that's gonna help. And you can't even google how to fix it because you need wifi to google things!

The other thing that's kinda scary is how fast everything changes. Remember when flip phones were cool? That was like five minutes ago. Now my phone has better specs than the computers they used to go to the moon. Bonkers.
